messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.62
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.62) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

We fixed a couple of small bugs, in summary.scanone() for format="onepheno" and in read.cross() for format="csvs".

Karl Broman

messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.34
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.34) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

The main changes are:

  - a new function find_dup_markers(), for identifying subsets of markers with identical genotype data

  - change of two function names, read_csv() to fread_csv() and read_csv_numer() to fread_csv_numer(), to avoid conflicts with other packages

A complete list of changes is at https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/blob/main/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
